Hi Samir / Rebecca,

Thanks again for the conversation today — really appreciate the context on your real-time transcription use case and the throughput targets you shared. Quick recap from my side so we're aligned: 

- Primary goal: reduce per-token inference cost while meeting 150ms p50 latency for 1-2k concurrent streams during peak.
- Non-functional: HIPAA constraints, strict logging/audit retention, preferred cloud region: us-west.
- ML requirements: quantized model support, prefix caching for repeated patient prompts.
- Ops requirements: predictable capacity and rollout controls for model updates.

Next step: we'd like to schedule a 60-90 minute technical deep dive with your ML and infra leads to review architecture, validation plan, and a short demo of the runtime. Proposed attendees: 
- From Acme: Priya Natarajan (ML lead), Vivek Kulkarni (infra/ops)
- From Redwood: Camila Reyes (ML platform lead), Dylan Brooks (runtime/ops), me (sales/solutions)

Suggested 60-90 minute slots next week (all PT):
- Tue 2026-07-13, 10:00-11:30
- Wed 2026-07-14, 14:00-15:30
- Thu 2026-07-15, 09:00-10:30

Proposed agenda (60-90 min):
1) 5-10m — Intros & goals for the session
2) 20-30m — Deep dive: model characteristics, tokenization, KV-cache patterns (Camila)
3) 20-30m — Runtime & infra: autoscaling, cold-starts, quantization tradeoffs (Dylan)
4) 10-15m — Demo: streaming & latency profiling (Marissa/Camila)
5) 10-15m — Q&A, next steps, action items (all)

I attached a short Redwood capabilities deck (redwood-capabilities-deck.pdf) to give the team a quick reference. Please let me know which slot works best and if there are additional items you want on the agenda (SOC 2, data residency, proof-of-concept timeline, etc.). Once we have a slot I'll send a calendar invite with dial-in details and a pre-read.

Best,
Marissa
